name: Neon sign
what: Words in boxed neon signs, a little crooked, light up one after another with a real tube flicker; a round badge pops, a sign buzzes off and back, the glow breathes under a string of lights.

learned_from.what: unlit signs lighting one by one with a flicker, the late flicker off and back, the haze and the lights

motion: signs in 10 f, 4 f apart; each lights with on 2 / off 2 / on 1 / off 3 / on; 12 f between signs; a badge back.out 12 f
